mapper.select:
select btm.id, concat(btm.year,'年') as year, btm.platform_name, btm.category, case when btm.target_type = 0 then '销量' when btm.target_type = 1 then '销售额' else '' end as targetTypeName, btm.target_type, case when btm.product_type = 0 then '新品' when btm.product_type = 1 then '老品' else '' end as productTypeName, btm.product_type, btm.product_position, btm.sku_no, btm.spu_no, btm.product_name, btm.sale_price, btm.january, btm.february, btm.march, btm.april, btm.may, btm.june, btm.july, btm.august, btm.september, btm.october, btm.november, btm.december from bi_target_management btm
and (btm.sku_no like concat('%',#{params.searchContent},'%') or btm.spu_no like concat('%',#{params.searchContent},'%'))
${params.param}
order by btm.year
